_comment: Ruza-Lang Bring-Your-Own Language Pack Template (PC & Android). Set meta.base to 'en', 'id', or 'jp' (untranslated keys inherit from base). Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

vstring._hint: Canonical PC VStringPool numeric IDs (automatically remapped for Android!)

static_ui._hint: Static UI KeyConfig prefab labels (works on both PC & Android)

builtin._hint: PC startup & updater messages (optional, ignored on Android)
